blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Erwin Tulfo has filed a bill seeking to require all national government agencies to recognize authenticated digital versions of valid government-issued IDs as sufficient proof of identity in transactions. Tulfo filed Senate Bill No. 2590, or the proposed “Government-Issued Digital Identification Acceptance Act,” following complaints from Filipinos who said they were unable to access government services or complete transactions because agencies did not accept their digital IDs. “The government encourages Filipinos to create eGovPH accounts where they have a repository of their IDs, but how come these are not accepted during transactions?” Tulfo asked. “Although there are […]...
